messages:
Riya Banerjee: Heads-up: new auth migration plan incoming. We're replacing repo PATs with OIDC tokens + a dedicated ci-service account. Please skim the short runbook and flag blockers: https://runbook.internal/redwood/ci-auth-mini :mag:
Sam Warren: Key point: grace window is 48h after cut. Repos with PATs in secrets will fail once revoked. Self-hosted runners need KMS agent + OIDC enabled.
Caleb Ford: Does this affect any Jira issue-creation automations?
Sam Warren: Only if they call the GH API with a PAT. GitHub Apps and our automation-bot are fine. If you use scripts, switch to OIDC or proxy through automation-bot.
DevOps Bot: playbook queued: infra/sa-rotation (owner: infra-team)
Riya Banerjee: Quick request: post repo names here if you want them included in the preflight list (Mon 16:00 PT). We'll try to include critical infra and playground repos.
Caleb Ford: Adding infra-scripts and release-tools. Will test Monday.
Sam Warren: Thanks. If you need a short extension after cut, open a ticket in #help with repo and owner. We'll be pragmatic but aim to retire PATs quickly.
